_comment: Notes for the translator about what a string means in the UI, keyed by dotted key path. Added to the prompt for that key only. Use it when a string comes out wrong because the English is ambiguous.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.pipContentOriginal: Option for which text the small floating Picture-in-Picture window shows: only the original spoken-language text.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.pipContentTranslate: Option for which text the small floating Picture-in-Picture window shows: only the translated text.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.pipContentSplit: Option for which text the small floating Picture-in-Picture window shows: both the original and the translated text.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.splitOrientation: Setting name: whether the two text panes (original and translated) are arranged side by side or stacked.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.orientationSideBySi: Layout option: two panels positioned horizontally next to each other, left and right. It does not mean 'indirectly' or 'sideways'.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.orientationStacked: Layout option: two panels positioned vertically, one on top of the other, like a stack. It does not mean 'overlapping'.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.modeSplit: Name of a display mode that shows the original and the translation in two separate panes.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.swapLanguages: Button tooltip: exchange the language being spoken with the language being translated into.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.swapUnavailable: 'Speech recognition' means automatically turning spoken audio into text (voice recognition). Use the standard phrase with correct grammar and gender agreement.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.modelsManagedByChro: Chrome is the web browser. The 'downloaded translation models' are language data packs the browser already downloaded.
SETTINGS.PROVIDER.bilingualHint: 'Recognizes' means the speech recognition can understand spoken English, not 'admits'.
STREAM.fromBroadcaster: Label shown to a viewer: the translation was made by the person who is broadcasting the live session, like a live streamer or host who shares captions with viewers. Do not use words that mean radio or TV transmitter, sender hardware, or a speaker.
LABELS.spokenLanguage: Setting name: the language the speaker talks in.
LABELS.uiLanguage: Setting name: the language of the app's own menus and buttons (the user interface).
LABELS.sameAsSpoken: An option in the interface-language dropdown. It must read naturally as 'Same as the spoken language' in a grammatically correct phrase.
STREAM.showTranslation: Label of a small button on the viewer's screen, followed by a colon and a language code (for example 'Show translation: FR'). Pressing it shows the translated captions next to the original ones. Translation here means translated text, not interpretation.
SETTINGS.TRANSLATION.translationFailing: Warning shown over the captions when the on-device translation stops working. The user can reload the web page to fix it.
CONNECTIONS.connecting: Status text while the app is in the middle of connecting; use a progressive form such as 'Connecting to OBS'.
